_doc: How much the company may decide without the owner. Read by every tool through co.gate(category) (company/tools/lib/company.js); changed only by the owner (node company/tools/governance.js set|preset --by <owner>), watched by locked-watch.js. Levels: auto = the accountable seat decides; notify = it decides and the owner is told the same day (company/owner/outbound.jsonl); approve = it proposes and waits for the owner (an owner question with a recommendation and a default). triage = the gate-triage decision model (company/decision-models/gate-triage, docs/DECISION-MODELS.md) chooses notify or approve from the facts the tool passes; shadow mode or any failure = approve. No preset uses triage: the owner opts a category in. Never for the fixed gates. The four owner gates (access, ownership, commitment, spend beyond the cap) are always approve and cannot be loosened.

_categories.hiring: opening a role and picking the hire
_categories.release: releasing or replacing a crew member
_categories.budget: setting or changing the metered cap, per-agent shares and pacing numbers (auto = auto budgeting)
_categories.spend: new spend inside the approved cap, including a new paid tool
_categories.models: changing which model a seat or routine runs
_categories.tools: shared changes to tools, house rules and policies (harness-change.js)
_categories.schedules: routine clocks, dispatcher tick and per-seat cadence, inside the owner's tempo bounds (docs/TEMPO.md)
_categories.external: anything that leaves the company (external-gate.js categories message, publish, form, network)
_categories.dashboard: agents adding or changing console panels
_categories.deps: adding a Python or Node package to the company environment (company/tools/deps.js): notify = install, then a one-line FYI to the risk seat; approve = an owner question with an Approve button first. Licence, age, install-script and typo exceptions are the risk seat's (AGPL the owner's) at every level.
_categories.org: the company's structure: creating a department, setting or changing its lead, moving a seat between departments (company/tools/departments.js; the CEO or the people function proposes, the CEO applies at this level, the owner always may). A company founded before this line existed reads the framework default.
_categories.profiles: changes to a crew member's profile proposed by the people function (company/tools/profile.js propose / decide): approve = the owner decides each on the Profile tab; notify / auto = the CEO may apply it (notify tells the owner). The owner's own edits are always immediate, whatever the level; temperament and counterpart changes always go through a trial. A company founded before this line existed reads the framework default.
_categories.packs: approving a capability pack (a new line of business: tools, seats, limits, meters); installing one is always the owner's (pack.js install). Approve in every preset.
